At its most fundamental level, time can be understood as a continuous, linear progression that allows events to unfold from the past through the present into the future. Ultimately, the nature of time remains a topic of ongoing investigation and debate, with different scientific disciplines offering varying perspectives and interpretations.

Despite extensive study, many questions about the nature of consciousness remain unanswered, such as how it arises, whether it is fundamental or derived from other processes, and whether it is unique to humans or present in other organisms.
